verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs confirm a time-off request API covering balance checking, submission, admin approval, and integration with payroll (gusto-docs-11, gusto-docs-19, gusto-docs-29, gusto-docs-50), which supports the approval-flows-into-payroll part of the story. However, there is no evidence of ops users defining PTO accrual policies (accrual rates, tenure-based rules, policy creation UI) — only balance checking and approval endpoints are documented, missing for 10: explicit accrual policy configuration/creation, policy management UI, and independent/hands-on confirmation that accruals feed payroll automatically.
